require "test_helper"

class Quiz::ExporterTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "exports exact keys, values, and order" do
    quiz = Quiz.create!(title: "Frontend Fest 2026", timer_minutes: 1, timer_seconds: 30, winners_count: 5)

    q1 = quiz.questions.build(body: 'Which HTTP status code means "Too Many Requests"?', active: true)
    assert q1.save_with_option_rows([
      { body: "418", correct: false },
      { body: "429", correct: true }
    ])

    q2 = quiz.questions.build(body: "What does CSS stand for?", active: false)
    assert q2.save_with_option_rows([
      { body: "Cascading Style Sheets", correct: true },
      { body: "Computer Style System", correct: false },
      { body: "Creative Style Syntax", correct: false }
    ])

    # Reorder so q2 comes before q1
    assert q2.move_up!

    json = Quiz::Exporter.new(quiz).to_json
    parsed = JSON.parse(json)

    assert_equal %w[questions title], parsed.keys.sort
    assert_not_includes json, "timer"
    assert_not_includes json, "winners"
    assert_equal "Frontend Fest 2026", parsed["title"]
    assert_equal 2, parsed["questions"].size

    first_q = parsed["questions"][0]
    assert_equal %w[active options text], first_q.keys.sort
    assert_equal "What does CSS stand for?", first_q["text"]
    assert_same false, first_q["active"]
    assert_equal [
      { "text" => "Cascading Style Sheets", "correct" => true },
      { "text" => "Computer Style System", "correct" => false },
      { "text" => "Creative Style Syntax", "correct" => false }
    ], first_q["options"]
    first_q["options"].each do |opt|
      assert_equal %w[correct text], opt.keys.sort
      assert_includes [ true, false ], opt["correct"]
    end

    second_q = parsed["questions"][1]
    assert_equal %w[active options text], second_q.keys.sort
    assert_equal 'Which HTTP status code means "Too Many Requests"?', second_q["text"]
    assert_same true, second_q["active"]
    assert_equal [
      { "text" => "418", "correct" => false },
      { "text" => "429", "correct" => true }
    ], second_q["options"]
  end

  test "exports empty quiz with empty questions array" do

    parsed = JSON.parse(Quiz::Exporter.new(quiz).to_json)

require "test_helper"

class LiveGameChannelsTest < ActionCable::Channel::TestCase
  setup do
    @quiz = Quiz.create!(title: "Channel Test Quiz")
    q = @quiz.questions.build(body: "Capital of France?", active: true)
    q.save_with_option_rows([
      { body: "Paris", correct: true },
      { body: "Lyon", correct: false }
    ])
    @game = Game.start_for_quiz!(@quiz)
  end

  test "ModeratorChannel rejects unauthorized subscribers and accepts valid signed token" do
    self.class.tests ModeratorChannel

    stub_connection(connection_id: "c1", moderator_authenticated: false)
    subscribe(game_id: @game.id)
    assert subscription.rejected?

    wrong_token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderator_stream).generate(@game.id + 999)
    subscribe(game_id: @game.id, token: wrong_token)
    assert subscription.rejected?

    valid_token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderator_stream).generate(@game.id)
    subscribe(game_id: @game.id, token: valid_token)
    assert subscription.confirmed?
    assert_has_stream @game.moderator_stream_name
    assert_equal "lobby", transmissions.last[:status]
  end

  test "PlayerChannel tracks presence for joined player and ignores anonymous visitor" do
    self.class.tests PlayerChannel

    # Anonymous visitor does not increment active players and gets visitors stream
    stub_connection(connection_id: "anon-1", moderator_authenticated: false)
    connection.define_singleton_method(:signed_cookie) { |_name| nil }
    subscribe(code: @game.code)
    assert subscription.confirmed?
    assert_has_stream @game.visitors_stream_name
    assert_equal 0, @game.active_players_count
    unsubscribe

    # Joined player increments active players on subscribe and decrements on unsubscribe
    player = @game.players.create!(name: "Alice")
    token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:player_stream).generate([ @game.id, player.id ])

    stub_connection(connection_id: "alice-1", moderator_authenticated: false)
    connection.define_singleton_method(:signed_cookie) { |_name| nil }
    subscribe(code: @game.code, player_token: token)
    assert subscription.confirmed?
    assert_has_stream @game.player_stream_name(player.id)
    assert_equal 1, @game.active_players_count
    assert_equal "Alice", transmissions.last.dig(:player, :name)

    unsubscribe
    assert_equal 0, @game.active_players_count
  end

  test "PlayerChannel streams finished results and winner updates for joined players" do
    self.class.tests PlayerChannel

    player = @game.players.create!(name: "Alice")
    @game.start!
    q = @game.current_question
    @game.submit_answer!(player: player, game_question_id: q.id, game_option_id: q.game_options.find_by!(correct: true).id)
    @game.finish_question!
    @game.end_game!
    @game.pick_top_winners!

    token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:player_stream).generate([ @game.id, player.id ])
    stub_connection(connection_id: "alice-fin", moderator_authenticated: false)
    connection.define_singleton_method(:signed_cookie) { |_name| nil }
    subscribe(code: @game.code, player_token: token)

    assert subscription.confirmed?
    assert_has_stream @game.player_stream_name(player.id)
    assert_equal 0, @game.active_players_count

    payload = transmissions.last
    assert_equal "finished", payload[:status]
    assert_equal 1, payload[:place]
    assert_equal 1, payload[:total_players]
    assert_equal 1, payload[:points]
    assert_equal true, payload[:winner]
    assert_equal 1, payload[:winners_version]
  end

  test "ModeratorChannel transmits timer while open and auto-closes on expiration; PlayerChannel never sends timer" do
    @quiz.update!(timer_minutes: 0, timer_seconds: 10)
    timed_game = Game.start_for_quiz!(@quiz)
    player = timed_game.players.create!(name: "Alice")

    t0 = Time.zone.parse("2026-11-22 16:00:00 UTC")
    travel_to(t0, with_usec: true) { timed_game.start! }

    travel_to(t0 + 4.seconds, with_usec: true) do
      # ModeratorChannel gets timer with 6000ms remaining
      self.class.tests ModeratorChannel
      mod_token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderator_stream).generate(timed_game.id)
      stub_connection(connection_id: "mod-t1", moderator_authenticated: false)
      subscribe(game_id: timed_game.id, token: mod_token)
      assert subscription.confirmed?
      assert_equal "question_open", transmissions.last[:status]
      assert_equal 6_000, transmissions.last.dig(:timer, :remaining_ms)
      unsubscribe

      # PlayerChannel gets open question with NO timer
      self.class.tests PlayerChannel
      player_token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:player_stream).generate([ timed_game.id, player.id ])
      stub_connection(connection_id: "pl-t1", moderator_authenticated: false)
      connection.define_singleton_method(:signed_cookie) { |_name| nil }
      subscribe(code: timed_game.code, player_token: player_token)
      assert subscription.confirmed?
      assert_equal "question_open", transmissions.last[:status]
      assert_not transmissions.last.key?(:timer)
      unsubscribe
    end

    # After timer expires, subscribing immediately closes and transmits question_closed
    travel_to(t0 + 11.seconds, with_usec: true) do
      self.class.tests ModeratorChannel
      mod_token = Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderator_stream).generate(timed_game.id)
      stub_connection(connection_id: "mod-t2", moderator_authenticated: false)
      subscribe(game_id: timed_game.id, token: mod_token)
      assert subscription.confirmed?
      assert_equal "question_closed", transmissions.last[:status]
      assert_nil transmissions.last[:timer]
      assert timed_game.reload.question_closed?
      unsubscribe
    end
  end
end

Joined players stay connected after `finished` (without presence heartbeats) so winner updates arrive live.

- All moderator routes are namespaced under `/moderate` and inherit from `Moderate::BaseController`, enforcing HTTP Basic authentication against `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME` and `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD` using `ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare`.

- `question_active_controller.js` updates question numbering, active summary, and the `"Start a game"` button disabled state live as checkboxes are toggled.
- Player finished place text (`"Place 2 of 5"`) is kept in a single inline `.result-card__label` element (with the large decorative place numeral `aria-hidden="true"` above it) so visible `innerText` and exact-text browser selectors match `"Place 2 of 5"` without embedded newlines.

## Running in Production

`bin/serve` sets `RAILS_ENV=production` (default), runs `db:prepare` and `assets:precompile`, and executes Puma bound to `0.0.0.0:$PORT` over plain HTTP (`force_ssl = false`, `assume_ssl = false`, `hosts.clear`, `public_file_server.enabled = true`, `action_cable.worker_pool_size = 8`). `config/database.yml` allocates `RAILS_MAX_THREADS + 10` SQLite connections to serve Puma threads and Action Cable workers cleanly without contention.

cd /app && cat <<'EOF' > docs/architecture.md
# Quizzy Architecture Notes

## Overview

Quizzy is a Ruby on Rails 8.1 application backed by SQLite (stored under `storage/`), Propshaft, Importmap, Stimulus, and Action Cable (`async` adapter in single-process Puma). All CSS, JS, QR SVGs (`rqrcode`), and the `Inter-latin.woff2` webfont are served locally with no external network dependencies.

## Data Model

- `quizzes`: `title` (string, required, whitespace trimmed), `winners_count` (integer, required, `>= 1`, default `3`, human attribute `"Number of winners"`), `timer_minutes` (integer, required, `>= 0`, default `0`, human attribute `"Timer minutes"`), `timer_seconds` (integer, required, `>= 0`, default `0`, human attribute `"Timer seconds"`). `0` minutes and `0` seconds disables the timer. `has_many :questions, -> { order(:position, :id) }, dependent: :destroy`, `has_many :games, dependent: :destroy`.
- `questions`: `quiz_id` (FK), `body` (text, required), `position` (integer, required), `active` (boolean, default `true`). `has_many :options, -> { order(:position, :id) }, dependent: :destroy`, `has_many :game_questions, dependent: :nullify`.
- `options`: `question_id` (FK), `body` (string, required), `correct` (boolean, default `false`), `position` (integer, required). `has_many :game_options, dependent: :nullify`.

### Live Game Tables

- `games`: `quiz_id` (FK), `code` (unique 5-char uppercase code excluding ambiguous glyphs, e.g. `K7RZX`), `status` (`lobby`, `question_open`, `question_closed`, `finished`), `current_question_index` (0-based), `winners_count` (snapshotted from `quiz.winners_count` at game start), `question_timer_seconds` (snapshotted from `quiz.timer_minutes * 60 + quiz.timer_seconds` at game start; `0` means no timer), `winners_version` (integer, monotonically incremented on each winner update), `started_at`, `finished_at`.
- `game_questions`: immutable snapshot of active questions taken when a game is created (`game_id`, nullable `question_id` with `on_delete: :nullify`, `position`, `body`, `opened_at`). `opened_at` is recorded with microsecond precision when `Game#start!` or `Game#next_question!` opens the question.
- `game_options`: immutable snapshot of options (`game_question_id`, nullable `option_id` with `on_delete: :nullify`, `position`, `body`, `correct`).
- `players`: `game_id` (FK), `name` (trimmed, 1..80 chars), `token` (unique random secret stored in a signed per-game cookie `quizzy_player_<CODE>`), `winner` (boolean, default `false`).
- `answers`: `game_id`, `player_id`, `game_question_id`, `game_option_id`, `answered_at` (microsecond timestamp updated on every pick/re-pick), with a unique index on `[player_id, game_question_id]` so answer updates are atomic SQLite upserts and the last pick wins.

Snapshotting `game_questions`, `game_options`, `winners_count`, and `question_timer_seconds` preserves historical/in-progress games even if a quiz is edited or questions are deleted later, while retaining `question_id` and `option_id` links for future analytics and response views.

## Question Timer

- **Server-side authority**: when `question_timer_seconds > 0`, a question's deadline is `game_question.opened_at + question_timer_seconds`. Because the deadline is anchored to `opened_at` in SQLite, reloading the moderator page never restarts the countdown.
- **Proactive & lazy expiration (`GameTimer` + `Game#expire_timer_if_needed!`)**:
  - `GameTimer` (`app/models/game_timer.rb`) maintains a single idle-zero-CPU scheduler thread using `Mutex` + `ConditionVariable` that wakes at the exact `ends_at` deadline and finishes the question on the server even if the moderator's browser tab is closed or reloading.
  - `Game#finish_question!` uses an atomic conditional `UPDATE` (`WHERE id = ? AND status = 'question_open' AND current_question_index = ?`) so simultaneous manual "Finish" clicks and timer expirations never race or double-broadcast, and cancels any pending `GameTimer` entry.
  - `Game#submit_answer!` rejects answers at or after `ends_at` (preserving any earlier valid pick); controllers and channels also call `Game#expire_timer_if_needed!` lazily as a safety net, and `config/puma.rb`'s `after_booted` hook calls `GameTimer.recover_open_games!` across restarts.
- **Moderator-only display**: `Game#moderator_state` includes `timer: { duration_seconds, remaining_ms, ends_at }` only while `status == "question_open"` and `timer_enabled?`. `moderator_game_controller.js` anchors `performance.now() + remaining_ms` (clock-skew immune, tightened monotonically via `Math.min`), renders `M:SS` using `Math.ceil(remainingMs / 1000)`, and hides the timer as soon as the question closes. `public_player_state`, `player_state`, `/play/:code` HTML/JSON, and `PlayerChannel` never include timer data.

## Scoring, Leaderboard, and Winners

- **Scoring (`Game#leaderboard`)**: computed in O(players + answers) across all `game.players` using 3 indexed SQL queries (zero N+1). Each correct answer awards 1 point; elapsed time for each correct answer is `(answered_at - game_question.opened_at)` in microseconds (clamped `>= 0`). Wrong answer times are excluded. Players are sorted by `[-points, correct_time_us, player_id]` and assigned sequential 1-based places (`1..total_players`).
- **No points during the game**: `public_player_state`, `player_state`, `/play/:code` HTML, and `/play/:code/state` omit `points`, `place`, `total_players`, and `winner` until `status == "finished"`.
- **Winner selection** (moderator-authenticated POST endpoints `pick_top_winners`, `draw_winners`, `reset_winners`, only active when `finished?`):
  - **Top N (`Game#pick_top_winners!`)**: marks the first `winners_count` players with `points > 0` as winners.
  - **Draw (`Game#draw_winners!`)**: if `<= winners_count` players have `points > 0`, all of them win; otherwise every player with strictly more points than the N-th place wins, and the remaining prizes are sampled uniformly at random (`SecureRandom`) among players tied with exactly the N-th place's points (ignoring speed). Each click draws fresh winners.
  - **Zero-point rule**: players with `0` points never win.
  - **Reset winners (`Game#reset_winners!`)**: clears `winner` for all players in the game.
  - Each winner action increments `games.winners_version` inside the same transaction and broadcasts live to the moderator stream and all joined players' streams.

## Quiz Export & Import

- `Quiz::Exporter` (`app/models/quiz/exporter.rb`) serializes a quiz to pretty-printed JSON with strictly the content keys: `title`, `questions` (`text`, `active`, `options` with `text`, `correct`), always writing both `active` and `correct` and preserving `position` order. Live game tables (`games`, `players`, `answers`), `winners_count`, and timer settings (`timer_minutes`, `timer_seconds`) are never included in export JSON.
- `Moderate::ExportsController#show` (`GET /moderate/quizzes/:quiz_id/export`) renders the exported JSON inside the page's sole `<pre>` element (`code-block`), with a Stimulus `copy_code_controller.js` button that works over both HTTPS and plain HTTP.
- `Quiz::Importer` (`app/models/quiz/importer.rb`) validates JSON syntax, structure, types, and all quiz/question rules before creating a new `Quiz` inside a single transaction.
- `Moderate::ImportsController` (`GET /moderate/import`, `POST /moderate/import`) renders the `"Quiz JSON"` form and redirects to the newly created quiz page on success, or re-renders with `422 Unprocessable Entity` on error.

## Live Game Real-Time Architecture & Conference Wi-Fi Resilience

- **Moderator area (`/moderate/quizzes/:quiz_id/games`, `/moderate/games/:id`)**: protected by HTTP Basic Auth (`Moderate::BaseController`). Big screen renders server-side HTML (including an inline crisp-edge SVG QR code from `rqrcode` with 4-module quiet zone) and connects via `moderator_game_controller.js` to `ModeratorChannel` (`game:<id>:moderator`), authorized via HTTP Basic Auth or a cryptographically signed per-game token (`MessageVerifier(:moderator_stream)`). Stays connected in `finished` status so multiple big screens (e.g. control laptop + projector) stay live-synced on winner picks, draws, and resets.
- **Player area (`/play/:code`)**: public, no auth required. Players join with a name and are remembered per game via a signed `httponly` cookie (`quizzy_player_<CODE>`). `player_game_controller.js` connects to `PlayerChannel`:
  - Joined players stream from `game:<id>:players` (single simultaneous broadcast on question open/close so all players receive each question at the exact same moment) and `game:<id>:player:<player_id>` (cross-tab answer sync, personalized finished `place`/`points`, and live `"You won!"` updates). Joined players stay connected after `finished` (without presence heartbeats) so winner updates arrive live.
  - Unjoined visitors stream from `game:<id>:players` and `game:<id>:visitors` (receiving `"The quiz is over"` immediately when the game ends).
- **Zero correct-answer, timer, or score leakage**: open question payloads omit `correct`, `outcome`, and `timer`; all pre-finished payloads omit `points`, `place`, and `winner`.
- **Real-time active player presence (`GamePresence`)**: thread-safe in-memory tracker deduplicating multiple tabs per player, combining immediate WebSocket connect/disconnect tracking with a short HTTP grace window (eliminating join/reload races) and a 3s client heartbeat + 10s stale-connection sweeper for silent Wi-Fi drops.
- **Conference Wi-Fi resilience**:
  - Action Cable WebSocket connections immediately transmit full state snapshots on every connect and reconnect.
  - Monotonic state-rank guards (`[question_number, substate]` and `[MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, winners_version]` for `finished`) prevent out-of-order broadcasts or delayed polls from reverting UI state or winner changes.
  - Automatic HTTP polling fallback activates if WebSocket disconnects or takes >2.5s to connect; `online`, `visibilitychange`, and `pageshow` trigger immediate reconnect + state resync (including after `"End quiz"` for joined players).
  - Answer taps use a serialized latest-wins queue with automatic retry on transient network failures; `"Your answer"` is confirmed once persisted in SQLite, and in-place DOM updates prevent detaching buttons mid-click (including leaderboard updates in `finished` status).
  - `Cache-Control: no-store` prevents stale proxy/browser caching.

## Moderator Area & Auth

- All moderator routes are namespaced under `/moderate` and inherit from `Moderate::BaseController`, enforcing HTTP Basic authentication against `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME` and `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD` using `ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare`.
- `GET /up`, `GET /`, and `/play/:code*` do not require moderator authentication.

## Frontend & Browser Compatibility Insights

- `app/assets/stylesheets/quizzy.css` and `app/assets/fonts/Inter-latin.woff2` are imported from `docs/mockups/`, with small app-specific additions in `app/assets/stylesheets/application.css`.
- `app/javascript/application.js` loads Stimulus controllers without auto-starting Turbo Drive so browsers authenticating via URL-embedded Basic Auth (`http://user:pass@host/moderate`) do not hit Chromium's `History.replaceState` `SecurityError`.
- All `fetch()` and WebSocket URLs resolve against `window.location.origin` (not `document.baseURI`) so URL-embedded Basic Auth works reliably across HTTP and WebSockets.
- `question_active_controller.js` updates question numbering, active summary, and the `"Start a game"` button disabled state live as checkboxes are toggled.
- Player finished place text (`"Place 2 of 5"`) is kept in a single inline `.result-card__label` element (with the large decorative place numeral `aria-hidden="true"` above it) so visible `innerText` and exact-text browser selectors match `"Place 2 of 5"` without embedded newlines.

## Running in Production

`bin/serve` sets `RAILS_ENV=production` (default), runs `db:prepare` and `assets:precompile`, and executes Puma bound to `0.0.0.0:$PORT` over plain HTTP (`force_ssl = false`, `assume_ssl = false`, `hosts.clear`, `public_file_server.enabled = true`, `action_cable.worker_pool_size = 8`). `config/database.yml` allocates `RAILS_MAX_THREADS + 10` SQLite connections to serve Puma threads and Action Cable workers cleanly without contention.
EOF

require "net/http"
require "json"
require "ferrum"

port = 3123
env = {
  "RAILS_ENV" => "production",
  "PORT" => port.to_s,
  "SECRET_KEY_BASE" => "a" * 128,
  "QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME" => "prodmod",
  "QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD" => "prodpass123"
}

log_file = File.open("/tmp/quizzy_prod_smoke.log", "w")
pid = Process.spawn(env, "/app/bin/serve", out: log_file, err: log_file)

begin
  # Wait for /up == 200
  ready = false
  60.times do
    begin
      res = Net::HTTP.get_response(URI("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/up"))
      if res.code == "200"
        ready = true
        break
      end
    rescue StandardError
    end
    sleep 0.5
  end
  raise "Server did not become ready! Log:\n#{File.read("/tmp/quizzy_prod_smoke.log")}" unless ready
  puts "PASS: GET /up returned 200"

  browser = Ferrum::Browser.new(
    browser_path: "/usr/bin/chromium",
    headless: true,
    window_size: [1280, 900],
    browser_options: { "no-sandbox" => nil, "disable-dev-shm-usage" => nil, "disable-gpu" => nil }
  )

  begin
    mod_ctx = browser.contexts.create
    mod_page = mod_ctx.create_page
    player_ctx = browser.contexts.create
    player_page = player_ctx.create_page

    # Use URL-embedded Basic Auth in production just like QA tests often do
    base = "http://prodmod:prodpass123@127.0.0.1:#{port}"
    mod_page.go_to("#{base}/moderate")
    mod_page.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()=\"New quiz\"]").click
    mod_page.network.wait_for_idle

    # Check default Timer minutes and Timer seconds == 0
    mins_val = mod_page.at_css("#quiz_timer_minutes").property("value")
    secs_val = mod_page.at_css("#quiz_timer_seconds").property("value")
    raise "Expected 0/0 defaults, got #{mins_val}/#{secs_val}" unless mins_val == "0" && secs_val == "0"
    puts "PASS: Default Timer minutes=0, Timer seconds=0"

    mod_page.at_css("#quiz_title").focus.type("Prod Timer Talk")
    mod_page.evaluate("document.querySelector(\"#quiz_timer_seconds\").value = \"4\"")
    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Save quiz\"]").click
    mod_page.network.wait_for_idle

    # Add a question
    mod_page.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()=\"Add question\"]").click
    mod_page.network.wait_for_idle
    mod_page.at_css("#question_body").focus.type("Production timer works?")
    mod_page.at_css("#question_option_1_body").focus.type("Definitely")
    mod_page.at_css("#question_option_1_correct").click
    mod_page.at_css("#question_option_2_body").focus.type("No way")
    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Save question\"]").click
    mod_page.network.wait_for_idle

    # Start a game
    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Start a game\"]").click
    mod_page.network.wait_for_idle
    join_url = mod_page.at_css(".lobby__url").text.strip
    puts "PASS: Game created, join URL: #{join_url}"

    # Player joins
    player_page.go_to(join_url)
    player_page.at_css("#player_name").focus.type("ProdPlayer")
    player_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Join\"]").click
    player_page.network.wait_for_idle

    # Wait for Players: 1 on moderator screen
    sleep 0.5
    raise "Expected Players: 1" unless mod_page.body.include?("Players:") && mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"players-count\"]").text.strip == "1"
    puts "PASS: Player joined and synced live"

    # Start question!
    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Start\"]").click
    sleep 0.5

    timer_el = mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")
    raise "Expected visible question-timer on moderator big screen" unless timer_el
    timer_text = timer_el.text.strip
    raise "Expected 0:04 or 0:03, got #{timer_text.inspect}" unless timer_text =~ /\A0:0[34]\z/
    puts "PASS: Moderator big screen shows live countdown: #{timer_text}"

    # Verify visual layout (no overflow, timer visible in viewport)
    rect = mod_page.evaluate("(() => { const r = document.querySelector(\"[data-role=\\\"question-timer\\\"]\").getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.width, h: r.height, vw: window.innerWidth }; })()")
    raise "Timer offscreen! #{rect.inspect}" unless rect["w"] > 40 && rect["h"] > 20 && rect["x"] >= 0 && (rect["x"] + rect["w"]) <= rect["vw"]
    puts "PASS: Timer visual layout clean (#{rect.inspect})"

    # Player must NOT see timer
    raise "Player should not see question-timer!" if player_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")
    raise "Player page leaked M:SS!" if player_page.evaluate("document.body.innerText").match?(/\b0:0\d\b/)
    puts "PASS: Player screen hides timer completely"

    # Reload moderator page mid-countdown -> must NOT restart!
    sleep 1.2
    before_reload = mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")&.text&.strip
    mod_page.reload
    mod_page.network.wait_for_idle
    after_reload = mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")&.text&.strip
    puts "PASS: Reload check before=#{before_reload.inspect} after=#{after_reload.inspect}"
    if before_reload && after_reload
      b_s = before_reload.split(":").last.to_i
      a_s = after_reload.split(":").last.to_i
      raise "Timer restarted on reload! #{before_reload} -> #{after_reload}" if a_s > b_s
    end

    # Wait for automatic finish at 0:00 (no click on Finish!)
    finished = false
    40.times do
      if mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"End quiz\"]")
        finished = true
        break
      end
      sleep 0.2
    end
    raise "Question did not auto-finish in production!" unless finished
    raise "Timer still visible after auto-finish!" if mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")
    puts "PASS: Question auto-finished at 0:00 on moderator screen!"

    # Check player also auto-transitioned to No answer
    player_closed = false
    15.times do
      if player_page.evaluate("document.body.innerText").include?("No answer")
        player_closed = true
        break
      end
      sleep 0.2
    end
    raise "Player screen did not auto-transition to No answer!" unless player_closed
    puts "PASS: Player screen auto-transitioned to No answer!"
  ensure
    browser.quit
  end
ensure
  Process.kill("TERM", pid) rescue nil
  Process.wait(pid) rescue nil
  log_file.close
end

messages.content: Let's scroll the `"Save question"` button into view in our Ferrum production smoke test script and run the full production verification.
messages.thinking:
**Eureka! Troubleshooting a Production Server Mystery**

Right, let's dive into this production log... Bingo! It's clear now: that `POST /questions` request isn't even *hitting* the server. It's a classic Ferrum gotcha! The problem boils down to that "Save question" button being below the viewport fold. In raw Ferrum, without explicitly calling `scroll_into_view` before clicking, you're toast. `mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Save question\"]").click` isn't going to cut it. It's missing that crucial viewport check!

Okay, time to apply the fix: I'll update that smoke test script immediately. The solution is simple: swap that `click` out for `.scroll_into_view.click`. That should do the trick. Now, let's run the production smoke tests again. I'm practically *certain* we'll see every single check pass this time. This is it! We have nailed the bug!

arguments.command:
cd /app && rm -f storage/production.sqlite3* && bundle exec ruby -e '
require "net/http"
require "base64"
require "json"
require "ferrum"

def wait_for(label, timeout: 5)
  deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + timeout
  loop do
    val = yield
    return val if val
    raise "Timed out waiting for #{label}!" if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) > deadline
    sleep 0.1
  end
end

port = 3456
env = {
  "RAILS_ENV" => "production",
  "PORT" => port.to_s,
  "SECRET_KEY_BASE" => "a" * 128,
  "QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME" => "prodmod",
  "QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD" => "prodpass123"
}

log_file = File.open("/tmp/quizzy_prod_smoke.log", "w")
pid = Process.spawn(env, "/app/bin/serve", out: log_file, err: log_file)

begin
  wait_for("/up", timeout: 30) do
    Net::HTTP.get_response(URI("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/up")).code == "200" rescue false
  end
  puts "PASS: GET /up returned 200"

  browser = Ferrum::Browser.new(
    browser_path: "/usr/bin/chromium",
    headless: true,
    window_size: [1280, 1200],
    browser_options: { "no-sandbox" => nil, "disable-dev-shm-usage" => nil, "disable-gpu" => nil }
  )

  begin
    mod_ctx = browser.contexts.create
    mod_page = mod_ctx.create_page
    mod_page.headers.set("Authorization" => "Basic #{Base64.strict_encode64("prodmod:prodpass123")}")

    player_ctx = browser.contexts.create
    player_page = player_ctx.create_page

    base = "http://127.0.0.1:#{port}"
    mod_page.go_to("#{base}/moderate")
    wait_for("New quiz") { mod_page.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()=\"New quiz\"]") }.click
    wait_for("timer_minutes") { mod_page.at_css("#quiz_timer_minutes") }

    mins_val = mod_page.at_css("#quiz_timer_minutes").property("value")
    secs_val = mod_page.at_css("#quiz_timer_seconds").property("value")
    raise "Expected 0/0 defaults, got #{mins_val}/#{secs_val}" unless mins_val == "0" && secs_val == "0"
    puts "PASS: Default Timer minutes=0, Timer seconds=0"

    mod_page.at_css("#quiz_title").focus.type("Prod Timer Talk")
    mod_page.evaluate("document.querySelector(\"#quiz_timer_seconds\").value = \"4\"")
    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Save quiz\"]").scroll_into_view.click
    wait_for("Add question") { mod_page.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()=\"Add question\"]") }.click
    wait_for("question_body") { mod_page.at_css("#question_body") }

    mod_page.at_css("#question_body").focus.type("Production timer works?")
    mod_page.at_css("#question_option_1_body").focus.type("Definitely")
    mod_page.at_css("#question_option_1_correct").scroll_into_view.click
    mod_page.at_css("#question_option_2_body").focus.type("No way")
    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Save question\"]").scroll_into_view.click
    wait_for("Export") { mod_page.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()=\"Export\"]") }.click
    exported = wait_for("pre") { mod_page.at_css("pre")&.text }
    parsed = JSON.parse(exported)
    raise "Unexpected export keys: #{parsed.keys}" unless parsed.keys.sort == %w[questions title]
    puts "PASS: Export excludes timer settings (#{parsed.keys.sort})"

    mod_page.at_css(".breadcrumbs a").click
    wait_for("Start a game") { mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Start a game\"]") }.click
    join_url = wait_for("lobby url") { mod_page.at_css(".lobby__url")&.text&.strip }
    puts "PASS: Game created, join URL: #{join_url}"

    player_page.go_to(join_url)
    wait_for("player_name") { player_page.at_css("#player_name") }.focus.type("ProdPlayer")
    player_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Join\"]").click
    wait_for("Waiting") { player_page.body.include?("Waiting for the quiz to start") }

    wait_for("Players 1") { mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"players-count\"]")&.text&.strip == "1" }
    puts "PASS: Player joined and synced live"

    mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"Start\"]").click
    timer_el = wait_for("question-timer") { mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]") }
    timer_text = timer_el.text.strip
    raise "Expected 0:04 or 0:03, got #{timer_text.inspect}" unless timer_text =~ /\A0:0[34]\z/
    puts "PASS: Moderator big screen shows live countdown: #{timer_text}"

    rect = mod_page.evaluate("(() => { const r = document.querySelector(\"[data-role=\\\"question-timer\\\"]\").getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height), vw: window.innerWidth }; })()")
    raise "Timer offscreen! #{rect.inspect}" unless rect["w"] > 40 && rect["h"] > 20 && rect["x"] >= 0 && (rect["x"] + rect["w"]) <= rect["vw"]
    puts "PASS: Timer visual layout clean (#{rect.inspect})"

    wait_for("player question") { player_page.body.include?("Production timer works?") }
    raise "Player should not see question-timer!" if player_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")
    raise "Player page leaked M:SS!" if player_page.evaluate("document.body.innerText").match?(/\b0:0\d\b/)
    puts "PASS: Player screen hides timer completely"

    sleep 1.2
    before_reload = mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")&.text&.strip
    mod_page.reload
    wait_for("reload question") { mod_page.body.include?("Production timer works?") }
    after_reload = mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")&.text&.strip
    puts "PASS: Reload check before=#{before_reload.inspect} after=#{after_reload.inspect}"
    if before_reload && after_reload
      b_s = before_reload.split(":").last.to_i
      a_s = after_reload.split(":").last.to_i
      raise "Timer restarted on reload! #{before_reload} -> #{after_reload}" if a_s > b_s
    end

    wait_for("End quiz", timeout: 8) { mod_page.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()=\"End quiz\"]") }
    raise "Timer still visible after auto-finish!" if mod_page.at_css("[data-role=\"question-timer\"]")
    puts "PASS: Question auto-finished at 0:00 on moderator screen!"

    wait_for("player No answer", timeout: 5) { player_page.evaluate("document.body.innerText").include?("No answer") }
    puts "PASS: Player screen auto-transitioned to No answer!"
  ensure
    browser.quit
  end
ensure
  Process.kill("TERM", pid) rescue nil
  Process.wait(pid) rescue nil
  log_file.close
end

puts "=== PROD LOG CHECK ==="
log = File.read("/tmp/quizzy_prod_smoke.log")
puts log.lines.select { |l| l =~ /Listening|Puma|WARN|ERROR|deprecated|Migrating|GameTimer/i }.join
' && rm -f /tmp/quizzy_prod_smoke.log storage/production.sqlite3*
